bird-collage.title: Bird Collage
bird-collage.description: Live collage of birds detected by BirdNET on the LAN. Rendered by screenshotting the AvianVisitors kiosk page via the browser renderer.

baseUrl.label: BirdNET base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the BirdNET/AvianVisitors instance. Override the host if mDNS (.local) doesn't resolve from the server — e.g. http://192.168.1.42. A bare host or IP is fine; http:// is assumed.

hours.label: Time window (hours)
hours.description: 1 = last hour, 24 = last day, 168 = last week

imageUrl.label: Image URL
imageUrl.description: URL of the image to display in the album

bitmap-patterns.title: Bitmap Patterns
bitmap-patterns.description: Demonstrating using custom classes to create bitmap patterns. See /utils/pre-satori.ts for more details. Edit this recipe at /app/recipes/screens/bitmap-patterns.tsx

wikipedia.title: Wikipedia Article
wikipedia.description: A component that displays random Wikipedia articles.

bitcoin-price.title: Crypto Price Tracker
bitcoin-price.description: A component that displays the current cryptocurrency price and market data. Supports any cryptocurrency available on CoinGecko.

cryptoSymbol.label: Cryptocurrency Symbol
cryptoSymbol.description: The CoinGecko ID of the cryptocurrency (e.g., 'bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'cardano'). Defaults to 'bitcoin'.

weather.title: Weather Forecast
weather.description: A component that displays current weather data from Open-Meteo API. Supports configurable locations via latitude/longitude or location name.

location.label: Location
location.description: City or place name to fetch weather for

responsive-example.title: Responsive Example
responsive-example.description: An example component demonstrating responsive design patterns and layout techniques for bitmap displays.

tides.title: Tides & Weather
tides.description: A radial 24-hour clock showing tide height, wave height, weather conditions, moon phase, wind, and clothing recommendation. Tide and astronomical data are fetched from Open-Meteo and computed locally — no API key required.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the location to show tides for

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the location to show tides for

adhdinos.title: ADHDinos Comic
adhdinos.description: Displays the daily ADHDinos comic by Ryan Keats, pulled from the ComicCaster RSS feed.

nasa-iotd.title: NASA Image of the Day
nasa-iotd.description: Displays NASA's Image of the Day, pulled from the official NASA RSS feed.

show_title_bar.label: Show Title Bar
show_title_bar.description: Show the NASA wordmark and image title at the bottom. Set to 'hide' to show the image only.

nasa-apod.title: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day
nasa-apod.description: Displays NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day — the featured image alongside its title and explanation, scraped from apod.nasa.gov.

show_title.label: Show Title
show_title.description: Show the picture title. Set to 'hide' to omit it.

show_explanation.label: Show Explanation
show_explanation.description: Show the explanation text beside the image. Set to 'hide' for an image-only layout.

xkcd.title: XKCD with Hover
xkcd.description: Displays the latest XKCD comic by Randall Munroe, with its title and hover/alt text.

show_title.label: Show Title
show_title.description: Show the comic title above the image. Set to 'hide' to omit it.

show_alt.label: Show Hover Text
show_alt.description: Show the hover/alt text below the image. Set to 'hide' to omit it.

not-found.title: Not Found Recipe
not-found.description: A fallback recipe displayed when a requested recipe is not found.
